product.pump_durability.name: 水泵耐用性
product.pump_durability.include: 明确水泵过早损坏或使用期限内仍完好
product.pump_durability.exclude: 泵仅有声音、流量弱或故障部件未指明

product.water_flow.name: 出水表现
product.water_flow.include: 流量小、断续、抽水弱等出水表现
product.water_flow.exclude: 不能直接推断水泵寿命失效

product.leakage.name: 漏水与渗液
product.leakage.include: 产品漏水或明确否认、纠正漏水判断
product.leakage.exclude: 外部泼水不能记录为产品漏水事实

product.noise.name: 运行声音
product.noise.include: 安静、吵、异响及日夜场景差异
product.noise.exclude: 提到水泵不代表泵损坏

product.cleaning_effort.name: 清洗难度
product.cleaning_effort.include: 清洗、清理是否费力或方便
product.cleaning_effort.exclude: 仅易脏或仅安装复杂需分开

product.assembly_maintenance.name: 拆装与维护步骤
product.assembly_maintenance.include: 装回水箱、螺丝拆装、维护步骤繁琐
product.assembly_maintenance.exclude: 不自动认定清洗本身困难

product.residue_hygiene.name: 污垢与残留感知
product.residue_hygiene.include: 滑腻、毛发堵塞、易积污等观察
product.residue_hygiene.exclude: 不推断细菌、毒性或健康危害

product.control_connectivity.name: 感应、控制与连接
product.control_connectivity.include: 感应、APP连接和出水控制表现
product.control_connectivity.exclude: 转述须reported，不能作为本人确认故障

product.capacity.name: 水箱容量
product.capacity.include: 容量及加水频率是否适合使用场景
product.capacity.exclude: 容量不等于机身外形尺寸

product.cable_length.name: 电源线长度
product.cable_length.include: 电源线长短对布置的影响

product.appearance.name: 外观感知
product.appearance.exclude: 外观好不证明耐用性好

product.pet_acceptance.name: 宠物接受意愿
product.pet_acceptance.exclude: 饮水量多少不等于喜欢或拒绝；不宣称口感验证

product.drinking_behavior.name: 饮水行为观察
product.drinking_behavior.include: 用户观察到饮水量、频次变化
product.drinking_behavior.exclude: 不推断健康收益、临床效果或适口性原因

product.filtration_perception.name: 过滤效果感知
product.filtration_perception.include: 用户对清澈等可见表现的感知
product.filtration_perception.exclude: 外观清澈不证明微生物或化学安全

product.general_reliability.name: 整体运行可靠性感知
product.general_reliability.include: 未指明部件时描述整机运行稳定或未坏
product.general_reliability.exclude: 不得指定为水泵或核心部件寿命

product.safety_concern.name: 潜在安全担忧
product.safety_concern.include: 仅以potential_risk记录潜在风险担忧
product.safety_concern.exclude: 不把差点踩水推断为已受伤或电气事故

consumable.filter_life.name: 滤芯更换频率与寿命
consumable.filter_life.include: 频繁更换或滤芯很快失效
consumable.filter_life.exclude: 耗材寿命与整机水泵寿命分开

consumable.filter_cost.name: 滤芯成本
consumable.filter_cost.include: 明确滤芯或耗材费用高低
consumable.filter_cost.exclude: 未指明对象的贵不能归入滤芯成本

consumable.replacement_reminder.name: 滤芯更换提醒
consumable.replacement_reminder.exclude: 提醒不亮不直接证明滤芯失效

service.customer_support.name: 客服沟通与处理
service.customer_support.include: 响应时间、解释与维修沟通

service.return_process.name: 退换货流程
service.return_process.exclude: 不等同于性价比低或真实退货率

service.instructions.name: 说明书与操作指导
service.instructions.exclude: 说明差不证明产品已损坏

experience.overall.name: 整体使用感受
experience.overall.include: 明确针对整体产品的好用或不能用
experience.overall.exclude: 单一声音场景不能扩展到整体

experience.price_value.name: 价格感知
experience.price_value.include: 未指明部件的价格高低或整体价值感受
experience.price_value.exclude: 不自动指定为耗材成本
